A `function` passed as a callback gets its own `this`, so `this.save()` inside it only works if you add `.bind(this)`. An arrow function uses the surrounding code's `this`, and it's shorter.

A callback is left alone if an arrow function can't replace it: a generator, a function that calls itself by name, or one that uses `arguments` or `new.target`. By default a callback that uses `this` without `.bind(this)` is left alone too.

`--fix` rewrites the callback as an arrow function and removes `.bind(this)`.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"prefer-arrow-callback" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"prefer-arrow-callback" = ["error", {
  allowNamedFunctions = false,
  allowUnboundThis = true,
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```js
const prices = items.map(function (item) {
  return item.price;
});

button.addEventListener("click", function () {
  this.save();
}.bind(this));
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
const prices = items.map((item) => item.price);

button.addEventListener("click", () => {
  this.save();
});

// `this` is the button here. An arrow function would change that.
button.addEventListener("click", function () {
  this.classList.add("active");
});

// Calls itself by name
walk(tree, function visit(node) {
  node.children.forEach(visit);
});
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowNamedFunctions` | `false` | Allow a callback that has a name, which shows up in stack traces. |
| `allowUnboundThis` | `true` | Allow a callback that uses `this` without `.bind(this)`. With `false` it's reported but not fixed. |

{/* good {"options": [{"allowNamedFunctions": true}]} */}
```js
items.forEach(function logItem(item) {
  console.log(item);
});
```

{/* bad {"options": [{"allowUnboundThis": false}]} */}
```js
button.addEventListener("click", function () {
  this.classList.add("active");
});
```
